# Hexatronic rusar på rapporten – datacenter driver

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-07-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Hexatronic's CEO Rickard Fröberg discussed a Q2 that came in clearly ahead of expectations: operating profit of SEK 224m, a 10% adjusted margin and 11% organic growth, up from -2% in Q1. Data center sales grew 27% organically, driven mainly by the US, and Fiber Solutions profit rose 50% after cost cuts in Europe. The mood is positive: margins have improved for two quarters in a row, short interest has fallen sharply, and a cited in-house analyst had called this the last weak quarter, although Q3 Fiber Solutions guidance is only flat versus Q2.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HTRO — Hexatronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Q2 beat expectations; organic growth turned positive; margins improved two quarters in a row; analyst called this the last weak quarter; short interest down sharply.

#### Reasoning

Operating profit of SEK 224m beat expectations, with organic growth swinging from -2% to +11%. Data centers grew 27% organically on US hyperscaler demand, and Fiber Solutions profit rose 50% after ~SEK 100m of cost cuts plus volume leverage. More price increases are coming next quarter. The NKT-backed second subsea line doubles capacity (~SEK 500m) at good margins. The cited in-house analyst expects a clearly better pace ahead, and falling short interest removes pressure. - if data center growth slows sharply beyond the guided deceleration
- if Q3 Fiber Solutions results fall below Q2 levels
- if input cost inflation (glass, polyethylene) cannot be passed through in prices
